Progress 2026-10-10 (branch work/phrf-custody-symlink-hashlock, commit 0610beec, not pushed): fixed reconciliation checklist items 6 and 7 per owner decisions.
(6) phrf_custody checkout accepts a tracked symlink only as a canonical relative in-tree alias of a tracked regular file (no absolute, '..', '.', or empty component; no chains even in-tree; dangling, directory and submodule targets refused with specific errors). Accepted links are materialised as real symlinks (core.symlinks=true), re-verified on disk, and listed in the stamp as tracked_symlinks. A full prepare() of this repo at 0610beec accepted CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md with a clean tree.
(7) requirements.lock regenerated with sha256 hashes for all 20 packages (top-level versions unchanged; transitive set = 2026-10-10 freeze; pip install --require-hashes reproduces that freeze exactly). tests/test_lockfile.py fails on any hashless pin. Runbook updated.
Evidence: custody suite 223 passed, 0 skipped (Python 3.12.13 hash-locked venv). phrfComparisonJVM/test with PHRF_REQUIRE_INTEROP=1: 476 total, 471 passed, 0 failed, 5 opt-in skips; InteropSuite 5, SealSuite 11, SealedStoreSuite 12 passed.
S9 stays open: owner key and fingerprint, beacon round, freeze, and owner checklist items 1-5 and 8-13 remain pending.
